settings.validator: offline exact IANA TZ database identifier resolution; aliases are normalized only by the accepted timezone library contract and unknown identifiers reject
settings.bounds: UTF-8 1..255 bytes; no free-form offset-only value

rules: Reading the setting creates no row; absent storage yields the accepted default America/Guayaquil.
This setting affects only LLD-05 Task/Objective scheduling input interpretation, Objective calendar bucketing/monthly ordinal and scheduling presentation.
Changing the setting never rewrites accepted Task-plan UTC instants, Task execution instants, source evidence, completed report labels or historical Objective evidence.
Ordinary application chronology and LLD-06 SLA chronology remain America/Guayaquil under their owning contracts; OBJECTIVE_TIMEZONE_V1 is not a global application timezone.
A user who wants existing schedule wall-clock labels preserved under the new timezone must perform separately governed explicit Task-plan reschedule/correction commands.
